brief: 需求：我们是一家社区咖啡店「豆仓 Bean Barn」，想要一个温暖、手作感的LOGO，配色偏棕色和奶油色，还需要名片和外带杯包装设计。预算800元，希望一周内完成。

analysis.summary_zh: 豆仓 Bean Barn 想要一个温馨、手作风格的标志，以棕色和奶油色为主色调，并设计名片和外带杯包装。

cases.title: 茄乐多 TOMATO · 生鲜零售品牌
cases.desc: 番茄的圆形果身构成字母 Q，小尾巴是一片新鲜绿叶，取「茄」的拼音首字母，也有 Q 弹可爱的意思；英文 TOMATO 的两个 O 画成小番茄，下面一条微笑弧线。番茄红 + 叶绿，在门头、购物袋、价签和小程序图标上都醒目亲切。

cases.title: 缇莫拉 TIMORA · 草本大健康品牌
cases.desc: 两片草本叶子相拥成一个太极圆，一青一金，寓意阴阳调和、内外平衡，也对应品牌的两条产品线。黛青代表草本与健康，暖金代表品质与温度；中文用端正的宋体风格字，英文 TIMORA 用古典衬线体，适合礼盒包装、电商主图和门店。

bid_zh:
尊敬的客户，

我叫Hongpeng，是一位独立手作感logo设计师。我很高兴为您提供豆仓Bean Barn的logo设计服务。

豆仓是一家咖啡店，我将为您设计一个温暖、舒适的手作感logo，色彩为棕色和奶油色，营造出温馨的氛围。价格为 ¥699，包含3天内初稿和2次修改。

我拥有丰富的案例作品，包括茄乐多和缇莫拉等品牌的设计，这些作品体现了我的设计理念和手作风格。

我承诺将尽力满足您的需求，并以个人设计师的诚意和专业性为您服务。期待与您合作！

敬礼，
bid_en:
Subject: Logo Design Proposal - Bean Barn

Dear Bean Barn,

I’m Hongpeng, a freelance logo designer. I’ve reviewed your project – Bean Barn, a warm, handcrafted coffee shop – and believe a hand-drawn logo would be a perfect fit.

My portfolio includes designs for TOMATO and TIMORA, showcasing a comfortable, rustic aesthetic. I’m proposing a price of $98.

I’ll deliver initial drafts within 3 days and two revision rounds.Sincerely,

Hongpeng
checklist:
- [ ] Logo Variations (Horizontal & Vertical): 3 variations for different applications (business cards, website header, social media profile).
- [ ] Color Palette: Primary color (Warm Brown), Secondary color (Cream), Accent color (Light Brown/Tan) – finalized.
- [ ] Logo Markup (for print):  File format: .ai or .eps, version: 300 DPI.
- [ ] Logo in .PNG format: 640x640 pixels, version: 300 DPI.
- [ ] Logo in .JPG format: 1000x1000 pixels, version: 300 DPI.
- [ ] Logo in .SVG format:  Version: 300 DPI.
- [ ] Logo in .PDF format:  Version: 300 DPI.
- [ ] Brand Style Guide (Basic):  Include logo usage guidelines – color, size, spacing, typography – for future use.
prompts:
1.  **Vintage Coffee Bean Illustration:** A softly illustrated, hand-drawn bean shape with a warm, slightly textured brown background, evoking a traditional coffee bean illustration.
2.  **Rustic & Cozy Coffee Cup:** A stylized, slightly imperfect coffee cup silhouette with a hand-painted cream color border and a subtle, warm brown shadow.
3.  **Organic Leaf & Bean Combination:** A minimalist design featuring a stylized coffee bean cradled within a simple, organic-shaped leaf, using a muted brown and cream color palette.
